Runs smoothly on any device, very challenging but also intuitive and easy to pick up. Every replay is different. Very fun.
I own this game on Steam and Nintendo Switch. Risk of Rain is a very fun platformer roguelike and I cannot wait for the upcoming remaster.

[h1] Where the monsters are tough but the real challenge is getting your computer to survive it [/h1]
Risk of Rain is the perfect game for anyone who's ever wanted to fight off waves of aliens while stranded on a hostile planet.

[h2] Pros and cons [/h2]
[table]
[tr]
[th] 🟩 Positives [/th]
[th] 🟥 Negatives [/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td]
- Replayability: The randomly generated levels and various playable characters make each playthrough unique and provide a good amount of variety.

- Difficulty progression: The game's difficulty increases as players progress, providing a satisfying sense of progression.

- Retro-style graphics: The game's retro-style graphics and chiptune soundtrack are charming and add to the overall atmosphere of the game.

- Smooth controls: The controls are smooth and responsive, making it easy to navigate through the levels and fight off enemies

- Power-ups and items: The game's variety of power-ups and items to collect gives players a sense of progression and encourages them to explore the levels.
	[/td]
	[td]
- Performance issues: Some players have reported that the game can have performance issues, particularly on the final level, if their computer does not meet the recommended requirements.

- Limited content: You may find that the game does not have enough content to keep them engaged for an extended period of time.

- Difficulty spikes: The game can be challenging at times, and some players may find that difficulty spikes can make it frustrating to play.

- Lack of story: The game is focused on gameplay rather than story, which may not appeal to some players.
	[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]	

[h2] Gameplay [/h2]
One of the game's strengths is its replayability. With randomly generated levels, a variety of playable characters, and an array of power-ups and items to collect, Risk of Rain is like a "Choose Your Own Adventure" book for people who like to shoot things. And let's be real, who doesn't like to commit genocide?

[h2] Multiplayer [/h2]
But don't be fooled by the retro charm, this game will kick your butt. It starts off easy, but before you know it, your screen will be a constant seizure party. But don't worry, you're not alone in your misery, as the game offers a multiplayer mode that you can enjoy with your friends, and trust me, you'll need them. However, you will need to do some third-party bs to actually play it.

[h2] Conclusion [/h2]
In conclusion, Risk of Rain is a game that will keep you on your toes, and make you laugh, cry, and scream all at the same time. If that's not worth your time and money, I don't know what is.

[h2] Important Note[/h2]
1. Sadly Risk of Rain is now under Gearbox's ownership. 
2. There is now a "new" Risk of Rain 1 game which is a remaster of this game.
It's definitely not as good as it's 3D sequel, but it has good music, gameplay, and provides a good challenge
